_readme: Verger settings — edit and save, then restart Verger. obs.host/obs.port/obs.password must match OBS > Tools > WebSocket Server Settings (Show Connect Info). assets.plan is the service plan opened at launch, relative to this file — set it to plans/afternoon/plan.json for the afternoon service, or "" to start with no plan. See RUNBOOK.md next to this file. This file may sit on a USB stick; keep it beside START.bat.
